values.note: 53 electric sites on the booking site, three of them host sites (52-54), leaving 50 public; 48 take a 23-ft rig (lengths 15-50 ft; 42 and 45 are 15 ft); 9 pull-throughs. The park page's '53 Tent, Trailer & RV Campsites' counts the hosts.

note: GA DNR state park on the west shore of Lake Burton where Moccasin Creek (trout stream) enters, inside the Chattahoochee National Forest. Flat terrain, sites close together. Boat dock/ramp, ADA fishing pier, trout hatchery next door. --Claude
summary: Booking engine still gastateparks.reserveamerica.com (parkId 530181; deep link added as booking.url). Catalog: 50 public sites (53 less 3 hosts), all 30 A + water, sewer at 02-05; 15-50 ft (48 take 23 ft), 9 pull-throughs; $40 / $45 identical on Sat 2026-11-14 and Tue 2027-06-15 (stored 40-45 confirmed). Hookups, count 53 -> 50, max 50, pull-through, dump/showers/flush toilets/laundry added. Note: dropped count/'reservable via ReserveAmerica', added the hatchery/national-forest setting from the park page. Pin ~130 m from the per-site centroid (34.84496,-83.58781) - fine. Season (year-round) and military discount left. Phone and waterfront - see flags.
flags: Phone: stored 1-800-864-7275 is the statewide reservations line. The park page gives 'Park 706-947-3194'. Suggest 706-947-3194.

Waterfront re-audit lead (stored lakeview): the booking site tags only five sites 'Proximity to Water' - 02-05 (by GIS at 34.8444-34.8447,-83.5880 to -83.5884, beside the trout-hatchery raceways and Moccasin Creek, ~150 m from the lake) and 17 (34.84441,-83.58709, on the east loop road ~30-60 m from the Lake Burton cove across the road and an open lawn with the park buildings). The rest of the pads sit under canopy 100-250 m from the lake. A lake view from the pads is plausible only at 17 and its east-loop neighbours; needs the gate's look.
